guilds.name: Land and Nature Stewardship
guilds.description: This guild focuses on sustainable land management practices, including soil health, water conservation, and biodiversity preservation.

guilds.name: Energy and Climate
guilds.description: This guild explores renewable energy sources, energy efficiency, and climate change mitigation strategies.

guilds.name: Buildings and Infrastructure
guilds.description: This guild emphasizes eco-friendly building materials, energy-efficient design, and sustainable infrastructure development.

guilds.name: Tools and Technology
guilds.description: This guild incorporates innovative tools and technologies that promote sustainability and efficiency in various aspects of permaculture practices.

guilds.name: Health and Spiritual Well-being
guilds.description: This guild addresses the connection between nature, human health, and spiritual well-being, promoting holistic approaches to wellness within permaculture systems.

guilds.name: Finance and Economics
guilds.description: This guild focuses on sustainable economic models, alternative currencies, and fair trade practices within the permaculture community.

guilds.name: Education and Culture
guilds.description: This guild promotes knowledge-sharing, education, and the preservation of traditional and indigenous practices, while fostering a culture of sustainability and resilience.

guilds.name: Land Tenure and Community Governance
guilds.description: This guild explores land access, tenure systems, and community governance models that support equitable and sustainable land use.
